executive_hero.subtitle: Caymiska Caafimaadka ee Bulshada ku salaysan wuxuu dammaanad qaadayaa daryeelka bukaan-socodka, jiifka, iyo daryeelka hooyada ee in ka badan 3,500+ xarumaha caafimaadka dawladda iyo la-hawlgalayaasha guud ahaan dalka.

citizen_services.title: Xarunta Adeegyada Degdegga ah ee Muwaadinka
citizen_services.subtitle: Qalabka is-adeegga degdegga ah ee qoysaska Itoobiya si ay u xaqiijiyaan caymiska, u helaan xarumaha caafimaadka, ayna u bixiyaan lacagaha sannadlaha ah.

eligibility_tab.title: Xaqiiji Xaaladda Caymiska Qoyskaaga
eligibility_tab.subtitle: Geli 16-ka lambar ee Aqoonsiga Qaranka Fayda ama lambarka kaarka xubinnimada CBHI ee xaafadda si aad u hubiso caymiska firfircoon.
eligibility_tab.result_desc: ✓ U qalma adeegyada bilaashka ah ee dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka dadweynaha iyo cisbitaalada tixraaca ee qandaraaska kula jira.

facilities_tab.title: Xarumaha Dadweynaha iyo Tixraaca ee Qandaraaska leh
facilities_tab.subtitle: In ka badan 3,500 xarumood ayaa aqbala kaararka CBHI guud ahaan Itoobiya.

payment_tab.title: Isku-xirka Lacag-bixinta Dijitaalka ah ee Fudud
payment_tab.subtitle: Bixi lacagta sannadlaha ah ee qoyskaaga adoon gelin safaf dhaadheer.
payment_tab.telebirr_desc: Fur Telebirr > Adeegyada > Lacag-bixinta Dawladda > CBHI > Geli Koodhka Degmada.
payment_tab.cbe_desc: CBE Birr ama si toos ah uga bixi laanta bangiga akoonka wadajirka ah ee CBHI ee gobolkaaga.
payment_tab.siinqee_desc: Miisas adeeg oo gaar ah ayaa ku yaal dhammaan laamaha gobollada.

emergency_tab.hotline_title: Khadka Tooska ah ee Xuquuqda Caafimaadka Qaranka 24/7
emergency_tab.hotline_desc: Haddii xarun caafimaad oo qandaraas kula jirta ay diido adeegyada ama ay dalbato lacag aan la oggolayn, si degdeg ah uga wac khadkayaga lacag-la'aanta ah:
emergency_tab.entitlement_1: Lacag la'aan la-talinta bukaan-socodka iyo baadhitaannada shaybaadhka muhiimka ah.
emergency_tab.entitlement_2: Hoyga buuxa ee cisbitaalka, qalliinka, iyo khidmadaha sariirta daryeelka degdegga ah.
emergency_tab.entitlement_3: Daawooyinka muhiimka ah waxaa si toos ah looga bixiyaa cisbitaalka ama farmashiyaha Kenema.

community_stories.title: Sheekooyinka Dhabta ah ee Ilaalinta Caafimaadka
community_stories.subtitle: Sida Caymiska Caafimaadka ee Bulshada ku salaysan uu malaayiin qoysaska Itoobiyaanka ah uga ilaaliyo daymaha caafimaad ee culus.
community_stories.difference_title: Farqiga uu CBHI u Sameeyo Qoysaska Itoobiyaanka ah
community_stories.without_cbhi_1: Qoysasku waxay dib u dhigaan daryeelka caafimaad cabsi ay ka qabaan kharashyo aan la filayn awgeed.
community_stories.without_cbhi_2: Jiifka cisbitaalka ee degdegga ah wuxuu inta badan sababaa in la iibiyo hanti iyo xoolo.
community_stories.without_cbhi_3: Cudurrada dabadheeraada waxay horseedaan wareegyo deyn ah iyo daaweyn la waayo.
community_stories.with_cbhi_1: Baadhitaan hore iyo daaweyn xarumaha caafimaadka xaafadda iyadoo aan lacag la bixin.
community_stories.with_cbhi_2: Qalliinka weyn iyo daryeelka cisbitaalka tixraaca waxaa si buuxda u daboolaya sanduuqa bulshada.
community_stories.with_cbhi_3: Kaydka qoyska iyo xasilloonida maskaxda waxaa lagu sugaa isku-duubnida bulshada.

stories.name: Almaz Tefera & Qoyskeeda
stories.quote: Markii ilmahayga ugu yar uu u baahday qalliin degdeg ah, biilka cisbitaalku wuxuu nagu qasbi lahaa inaan iibinno dhulkayaga beerta. CBHI dartiis, wax walba 100% waa la daboolay iyadoo aan wax kharash ah nalaga qaadin.

stories.name: Mulugeta Assefa
stories.quote: Daawooyinka macaanka iyo dhiigkarka, kharashaadka bil kasta ee farmashiyaha waxay ahaayeen kuwo aan la qaadi karin. CBHI waxay ii oggolaatay inaan daawooyinka bil kasta sharaf kaga qaato Farmashiyaha Kenema.

stories.name: Fatuma Kedir
stories.quote: Dhalmada badbaadada leh ee cisbitaalka iyo baadhitaanka mataanahayga waxay ahaayeen kuwo gebi ahaanba walaac la'aan ah. Kalkaaliyeyaasha iyo dhakhaatiirtu waxay noola dhaqmeen si sharaf leh.

health_rights.description: CBHI Itoobiya waxaa lagu aasaasay aaminaadda ah in daryeelka caafimaad ee tayada leh uusan waligiis ku xirnaan xaaladda dhaqaale. Iyada oo loo marayo isku-duubnida bulshada, waxaan isku geynaa kheyraadka si qoys kasta, iyadoon loo eegin dakhligooda, uu u helo adeegyada caafimaad ee aasaasiga ah.

equitable.title: Heli Galitaanka Sinnaanta
equitable.description: Xaqiijinta in muwaadin kasta, iyadoon loo eegin dakhligiisa, uu heli karo daryeel caafimaad oo tayo leh markuu ugu baahi badan yahay.

solidarity.title: Isku-duubnida
solidarity.description: Bulshooyinka oo isugu yimaada si ay isaga difaacaan naxdinta dhaqaale ee jirrada.

coverage.description: Laga soo bilaabo xarumaha caafimaadka aasaasiga ah ilaa qalliinka takhasuska leh, CBHI waxay dabooshaa waxa ugu muhiimsan.

primary.title: Daryeelka Aasaasiga ah
primary.description: La-tashiyo bilaash ah, baadhitaanno, iyo daaweyn aasaasi ah xarun kasta oo la-hawlgal ah.

hospitalization.title: Jiifka Cisbitaalka
hospitalization.description: Caymis buuxa oo jiif ah oo ay ku jiraan qalliinka, ICU, iyo adeegyada daryeelka kadib ee muhiimka ah.

maternal.title: Hooyada & Dhallaanka
maternal.description: Daryeelka dhalmada ka hor, dhalmada, carruurta iyo dhalmada kadib oo si buuxda loo daboolay qoys kasta.

enrollment.subtitle: Ku biirista CBHI waa mid fudud. Raac saddexdan tallaabo ee xafiiska degmadaada oo hel caymis isla maalintaas.

step1.title: Hubinta Aqoonsiga
step1.description: Iska diiwaangeli degmadaada adoo wata Aqoonsiga Fayda. Nidaamkayagu wuxuu si degdeg ah ugu xirmaa xaqiijinta.
step1.badge: Keen Aqoonsiga Fayda ama kaarka aqoonsiga qaranka

step2.title: Lacag-bixinta Sannadlaha ah
step2.description: Bixi khidmad sannadle ah oo yar iyadoo lagu saleynayo tirada qoyskaaga. Waxaa jira ikhtiyaarro lacag-bixineed oo dabacsan.

step3.title: Hel Caymis
step3.description: Si degdeg ah uga hel daryeel caafimaad xarun kasta oo la-hawlgal ah kaarkaaga CBHI ee dijitaalka ah ama jireed.

impact.subtitle: Natiijooyin la qiyaasi karo oo horseedaya isbeddelka daryeelka caafimaadka guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Federaalka Itoobiya.
